headline: Sensex Jumps 700 Points, Nifty Hits Fresh 10-Month High Above 25,700

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex rebounded sharply by 1,300 points from the day's intraday low.
Nifty 50 reached a fresh 10-month high of 25,730 during trading.
Bank Nifty crossed the 64,000 mark for the first time ever.
Financial and auto sector strength pushed key benchmark indices higher.
whatHappening: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty recorded strong gains on November 20, 2026.
Urban Company raised Rs 2,500 crore through a QIP that saw demand exceeding Rs 15,000 crore.
Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects received SEBI approval to proceed with its IPO.
A Bank of Baroda manager was arrested for allegedly demanding a bribe to sanction a loan.
summary: Indian equity markets surged on November 20, 2026, with the Sensex jumping 700 points and Nifty touching a 10-month high above 25,700. Bank Nifty crossed 64,000 for the first time as markets recovered 1,300 points from intraday lows. Stock-specific action included Urban Company's successful QIP raise and SEBI's approval for Pristine Logistics' IPO.
